reviews.title: Bad update
reviews.text:
I’ve absolutely loved using Howbout, but the latest update has really disappointed me!

Between working full-time, football coaching and U11s training, gym sessions, hiking, socials and family commitments and appointments, my calendar is incredibly busy so being able to colour-code everything was one of the app’s most useful features for me but now I’m restricted to preset colours unless I pay for a subscription, which has really taken away from the experience, especially as this was free before!

Paying for everything in the app is ridiculous, my apps turned into another calendar app. What now separates it in the market?

reviews.title: Going Downhill
reviews.text:
Scummy that you continue to lock more and more features that used to be included behind a paywall, especially for people like me that supported your app from the start and were a part of your Beta, to help you build and improve it.

It’s also pretty gross to raise the amount of friends even higher now for people to be able to see the feed, when you literally see people discussing their difficulties with making meaningful human connection, not to mention it is Discriminatory against Disabled and Neurodivergent individuals, as making, developing, and maintaining lasting friendships, is literally part of the criteria listed in the DSM-5 across multiple Disabling conditions, so Accessibility and Reasonable Adjustments should always be included as standard, as per the Equality Act 2010.

Also, just in general, people do not need an app reminding them they do not have “enough” friends to be included or to be able to access things, it’s not really ok or justifiable, no matter what way you look at it. It’s not far off these predatory apps that force you to give 5 stars before you can access certain features, basically using manipulative marketing tactics to use people for your own gain, rather than allowing them to decide for themselves whether they like your app and passing it on organically. 

When you add this to the constant removal of previously free features, it doesn’t really paint a great picture of your product and/or company to be honest.

reviews.title: Recent update - not a fan
reviews.text:
⭐⭐

I’ve used Howbout for a long time and genuinely really liked it. It was one of my favourite calendar apps because it was simple, intuitive and, most importantly, allowed me to organise my calendar using lots of different colours.

Unfortunately, this latest change has completely messed up the way I organise my life. I had a large number of different colours for different jobs, hobbies, projects, social events, theatre work, etc. Now that system has been drastically reduced and tied to categories, with more flexibility apparently sitting behind a subscription.

I understand that Howbout needs to make money, I have absolutely no problem with that. But repeatedly changing features that people already rely on and disrupting their existing organisation is incredibly frustrating. This also isn’t the first time an update has messed with the way my calendar was organised.

And £40 a year for a calendar app is, frankly, ridiculous to me, especially when there are plenty of other calendar apps available that offer the features I actually need without charging that much.

Because of this change, I’m deleting Howbout and moving to another calendar. It’s a real shame, because I genuinely liked the app before these changes.

I really hope the developers listen to the feedback and reconsider this direction. You risk losing loyal users when you take away functionality they’ve relied on for years.

reviews.title: Was good before the paywall
reviews.text:
I used Howbout for a couple of years and absolutely loved it. I originally started using it with my family after I moved out, and eventually added friends as all of our schedules became busier and harder to coordinate.

One of my favorite things about the app was how simple it was. It was free, you had access to all the colors, and I could easily color-code different activities and repeating events. As a very Type A person, I had YEARS of my calendar organized by color.

Unfortunately, Howbout changed the way colors work and started putting certain colors behind a paywall. They also changed how repeating activities can be created and color-coded.

I opened the app one day and suddenly all of my previously color-coded activities were grey. Years of organization and visual patterns were basically taken away without warning. That may sound small to some people, but when you’ve used an app consistently for years and built your entire calendar around a feature, it’s incredibly frustrating and honestly feels unfair to loyal users.

I ended up downloading TimeTree, which gives me essentially the same functionality for free, and I’m hoping they don’t eventually make the same kind of changes.

I genuinely loved Howbout, which is what makes this so disappointing, but unfortunately I’ve now uninstalled the app.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
I’ve never felt the need to review any apps before but after being a long-term user of Howbout and recommending to multiple people, I had to write something after being so disappointed with the recent update. 

As a busy Mum of 5 children I had colour coded for each child and myself/my husband etc. The fact that the colours had become limited had been annoying but still manageable. Since the latest update to now have custom colours completely behind a subscription has ruined the app and organisation available. It is no longer easy to glance at the calendar and know who’s got something on.

I’m aware you can have “categories” but for these to be set to Howbouts wording and not able to be custom wording without a subscription has made the ease of use disappear. 

Really disappointed in the changes and will probably move away from the app now. Frustrating as I have dates booked in for the next two years and will have to transfer everything over. Including relinking my skylink calendar with a new app as these colour changes have ruined that too. 

Contacted support on day one of the change and was told I was still able to have my own colours under “sort them myself”, however this is inaccurate as the wording is not my own and there are only a few colours to choose. 

Colour and label choices may seem like something small but when you’re trying to keep organised, the whole point of the app, it actually becomes a bigger issue.

I used to absolutely love this app and genuinely thought it was one of the best apps for planning, organising and keeping track of life with other people. It was simple, useful and actually enjoyable to use.

Unfortunately, the recent changes have completely changed my opinion. Features that used to be available for free, such as customising plan names and colours/categories, now seem to be locked behind a subscription. It feels like the app is becoming increasingly focused on making money from its users rather than improving the experience.

I understand that apps need to make money, but there’s a big difference between charging for genuinely premium features and putting basic customisation and functionality behind a paywall. It’s particularly frustrating when these are features I’ve been using for free for a long time.

What makes it even more irritating is the number of people I’ve recommended this app to over the years because I genuinely thought it was brilliant. I’ve told friends and family to download it because I loved how easy and useful it was. I certainly wouldn’t recommend it now.

reviews.title: Bad Update. Pushing for $$$.
reviews.text:
Used to love this app. It used to have a bunch of color options for users to choose from for individual plans, in whatever way users wanted. 

At some point it added special color theme options, where users could pay monthly for the app to sort users’ plans into a chosen color theme. “Howbout +”. 
It was fine before because it was a choice. 

Now, the recent update takes away users’ choice. 
You open the app, all of your carefully chosen colors for your plans? Gone. Everything’s grey. 

The app tells you, “Set up categories to bring your event colors back 🔔” 
But when you go to click on it, it’s not YOUR colors that come back. 

They force you to sort all of your past and current plans into categories: self, reminders, school, work, social. 

Any other custom category you have to pay for. 

Each category has a selectable color. The color options are HALF of what they were before, and the other color options they used to give users for free, you now have to pay for. 

Seeing a common theme? 

The app went from fun colorful planning app for you and your friends  to be grey (or bland colors in pre-selected categories) because of  the money they wanted to make. Money, money, money. More money. 

I guess not enough people were choosing to subscribe to the monthly Howbout+ before when it was an ad and therefore a choice. The app’s solution was to update to limit users and make previously FREE options  cost money. 

This update is not a good look.

reviews.title: Latest Update Ruined It
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this Calendar for over a year and it worked perfectly fine. Great, even. I recommended it to all my friends and family from a genuine place. 

Then, this morning I woke up and now all the color coding I’ve done in the last year (for 5+ events nearly every day) was completely gone. Now I have to pay to have a feature I’ve been using for a year? Words cannot describe how disappointed and upset I am. 
If this isn’t fixed soon, I guess I’m going to find ANOTHER new calendar app and hand-enter the copious events that already took me so much time.

reviews.title: Forced Invites
reviews.text: I downloaded this app expecting a simple, useful calendar tool, but instead I was immediately hit with a frustrating requirement to invite friends just to unlock basic features. I also don’t have a big contact list to begin with, so being forced to invite people just to access the app makes it even more inconvenient and exclusionary. That’s not a feature—it’s a barrier. I shouldn’t have to recruit other people just to use an app I already installed for personal organization. That said, the concept behind the app seems genuinely useful, which makes this restriction even more disappointing.

reviews.title: DELETED MY ENTIRE PHONE CALENDAR
reviews.text: I got this to do a shared calendar with my friends and when it didn’t work for me I deleted it. When I deleted it it deleted every. Single. Thing. In my iPhone calendar. Birthdays, national holidays, doctors appointments, special events, everything. If you rely on your apple calendar for everything and decide this calendar no longer works for you make sure you have everything saved. Apple support could not figure out what happened either. Do not download this app unless you are absolutely sure it is going to work for you because when you delete it everything will be gone.
